title: Manage dependencies with other teams
summary: In a larger organisation, your plan often depends on other teams' work. Find those dependencies early, agree them in writing and review them often.

beginner: List the work you need from other teams to deliver your plan.
Meet each team to agree what, when and who owns it.
Record each dependency with a date and an owner.
Raise a slipping dependency early, with options.
intermediate: Map dependencies in both directions: what you need and who needs you.
Agree interfaces and dates in writing.
Plan around high-risk dependencies, for example with a simpler first release.
experienced: Spot dependency patterns across teams and fix the cause, such as team boundaries.
Run a regular cross-team planning session.
Escalate systemic blockers to leadership with data.

canDelegateTo.task: Keep the dependency list up to date
Agree technical interfaces with other teams

toolExamples.jira: Link issues across projects to show dependencies.
toolExamples.miro: Draw a dependency map for planning sessions.

definitionOfDone: Dependencies listed with owners and dates
pitfalls: Finding them at the end of the plan

leaderView.good: Dependencies on other teams are found early, agreed and tracked.
ask: Which other teams do we depend on, and have they committed?
What happens if a dependency slips?

sources.title: How to manage agile team dependencies (Contino)
